items.title: Governing Agent Loops on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Agent loops can automate real multi-step work, but running them in production raises questions about cost, actions, and audit. This post shows how to build and govern agent loops with Amazon Bedrock and AWS-native controls. It also explains how to recognize when governance is better handled by a dedicated control plane, such as Blunom, that extends those controls across teams and clients.
items.creator: Marina Novikova
